title: Indus Valley Pottery Collection
description: A curated display of terracotta vessels, bowls, and storage jars recovered from fictional excavation sites modelled on Indus Valley urban centres. The collection illustrates everyday domestic life, trade networks, and the remarkable standardisation of craft production in ancient South Asia.

title: Ancient Trade Seals
description: Carved steatite seals bearing pictographic inscriptions and animal motifs. These objects were used as mercantile identity markers and administrative tools in Bronze Age trade. The exhibit includes facsimile impressions and interpretive diagrams explaining their possible administrative function.

title: Bronze Age Tools
description: An assortment of reconstructed and original Bronze Age implements including chisels, axes, and knives. The display contextualises metallurgical advances and their role in shaping early agricultural and urban societies in the fictional Meridian civilisation.

title: Traditional Textile Collection
description: Hand-woven fabrics, embroidered garments, and looms representing centuries of textile craft from the fictional Halcyon Region. Each piece documents the social significance of colour, pattern, and weaving technique as cultural identity markers.

title: Miniature Painting Collection
description: A collection of intricate miniature paintings on paper and ivory, depicting courtly life, mythology, and botanical subjects. The works demonstrate mastery of fine-line technique and natural pigment preparation used by artists of the fictional Velanthi court tradition.

title: Early Astronomy Instruments
description: Replica and original astronomical tools including astrolabes, armillary spheres, and graduated quadrants from the fictional Solaris Observatory tradition. The exhibit explains celestial navigation, calendar reform, and the mathematics underlying pre-modern astronomical observation.

title: Mechanical Engineering Models
description: Working scale models of historic mechanical devices: gear trains, water-powered mills, and printing press mechanisms. Each model is accompanied by annotated engineering diagrams and a demonstration panel explaining the underlying mechanical principles.

title: Fossil Display
description: Fossilised skeletal remains of prehistoric megafauna and marine invertebrates recovered from the fictional Stonewood Basin. The exhibit walks visitors through geological time, explaining fossilisation processes, stratigraphic dating, and evolutionary relationships.

title: Mineral and Crystal Collection
description: Over 200 mineral specimens, geodes, and synthetic crystal formations illustrating crystallographic structures, mineral hardness, and geological formation environments. Tactile samples allow visitors to compare texture and weight.

title: Biodiversity Diorama
description: A large-scale diorama representing four distinct biomes of the fictional Meridian continent: rainforest, grassland, desert, and coastal wetland. The exhibit highlights species interdependence, food web dynamics, and conservation challenges.

title: Historical Coin Collection
description: More than 300 coins spanning three fictional monetary traditions: the Meridian Republic, the Velanthi Principality, and the Coastal Trade League. The display traces changes in iconography, metallurgy, and economic policy across fictional centuries.

title: Regional Craft Exhibition
description: A rotating showcase of traditional crafts from six regions of the fictional Halcyon Nation: pottery, basketry, woodcarving, lacquerwork, metalwork, and bead jewellery. The exhibition includes live demonstration videos and artisan interviews.
